terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.subtitle: FAYRIX, S.A. DE C.V. (KRONIQ)
terms.address: CALLE SIERRA GORDA N°36, DESPACHO 305 MZ, COL. LOMAS DE CHAPULTEPEC I SECCION, ALCALDIA MIGUEL HIDALGO, C.P. 11000 ENTIDAD FEDERATIVA CIUDAD DE MÉXICO
terms.intro: A well-built brand needs clear agreements. These terms set the ground rules between KRONIQ and those who hire or browse its site: what can be expected, what is prohibited, and how conflicts are resolved.
terms.section01Content1: FAYRIX, S.A. de C.V. (hereinafter "KRONIQ" or "the Provider") is the design studio that provides the services described on the website.
terms.section01Content2: The Client is any natural or legal person who hires, requests a quote, or browses the KRONIQ website. By using the site or starting a project, the Client accepts these Terms in full.
terms.section01Content3: If you act on behalf of a company, you declare that you have the necessary authority to bind it. KRONIQ may request documentation that accredits that representation.
terms.section02Title: 02. THE SERVICES AND HOW THEY WORK
terms.section02Content1: KRONIQ offers strategic design services grouped into ten catalogs: visual identity, corporate branding, social media design, advertising banners, editorial design, illustrations, professional presentations, UI design for websites, editable templates and brand redesign. Custom packages are also offered under prior diagnosis.
terms.section02List1: The Client selects the service package of interest (or requests a customized combination) based on the information published on the KRONIQ website and/or the quote sent to them.
terms.section02List2: KRONIQ sends a formal proposal confirming the chosen package, its scope, deliverables, number of proposals and revision rounds included, estimated timelines, and investment.
terms.section02List3: Acceptance of the proposal (in writing or by electronic means) and payment of the corresponding deposit constitute the formal start of the project and result in the assignment of a unique file number.
terms.section02List4: The Client agrees to provide the brief, content, materials and information necessary for the development of the project within the agreed deadlines; any delay in the delivery of such inputs may modify the work schedule and estimated delivery dates.
terms.section02List5: In case of discrepancy between the general information published on the website and what is established in the formal proposal accepted by the Client, the terms, scope, deliverables, deadlines and investment indicated in said proposal shall prevail in all cases.
terms.section02Content2: Each package specifies the number of initial proposals and adjustment rounds included. Modifications that exceed that scope will be quoted as additional work with the Client's prior consent.
terms.section03Content1: All published prices are expressed in Mexican Pesos (MXN) and are subject to the applicable VAT. The price applicable to each project will be the one indicated in the formal proposal accepted by the Client, based on the packages and services described on the KRONIQ website.
terms.section03Content2: The invoice (CFDI) is issued no later than 3 business days after payment is confirmed, with the tax data provided by the Client. Retroactive invoices are not issued.
terms.section04Content1: This is perhaps the most important point of the agreement. Ownership of the final work is transferred to the Client once total payment is settled, with the following clarifications:
terms.section04Subtitle1: What the Client receives with the final files
terms.section04List1: Economic rights over the final designs delivered for commercial use under the agreed terms.
terms.section04List2: Files in the formats specified in each package (AI, EPS, SVG, PNG, PDF, Figma, etc.).
terms.section04List3: Moral copyright over the works created, in accordance with the Federal Copyright Law.
terms.section04List4: The right to include the finished project in its portfolio and presentation materials, unless an express confidentiality agreement exists.
terms.section04List5: Ownership of unselected proposals, preliminary sketches and discarded concepts; these are not delivered and cannot be used.
terms.section04Content2: Third-party materials: Fonts, stock photographs or plugins used in the designs are governed by their own licenses. KRONIQ informs the Client when a resource requires an independent commercial license.
terms.section05Content1: Both parties agree to treat as confidential any information marked as such or that by its nature should be: brand strategy, financial data, business plans, briefs, unpublished concepts and any material delivered during the project.
terms.section05Content2: This obligation remains in force during the project and for 2 years after its conclusion. KRONIQ will not disclose the content of briefs or Client materials to third parties not involved in the project.
terms.section06Content1: Delivery deadlines are established in the formal proposal and begin to count from the approval of the brief and payment of the deposit. KRONIQ will notify the Client in advance if any circumstance affects the schedule.
terms.section06Content2: Each package specifies the number of revision rounds. One round equals a consolidated set of comments delivered in a single message or document. Partial comments or changes of direction after approving a proposal are considered a new round.
terms.section06Content3: Final approval by the Client — in writing, by email or message — concludes the creative phase. Changes requested after approval will be quoted independently.
terms.section06Content4: Final files are delivered via secure download link, email or agreed platform. KRONIQ does not guarantee indefinite availability of the download link; the Client must back up their files.
terms.section07Content1: KRONIQ guarantees professional quality and compliance with the agreed scope. However:
terms.section07List1: It does not guarantee specific business results (sales, positioning, virality) derived from the use of the designs delivered.
terms.section07List2: It is not responsible for brand strategy decisions that the Client makes on their own using the deliverables.
terms.section07List3: It is not responsible for damages caused by incorrect use, unauthorized modification or deficient implementation of the files delivered.
terms.section07List4: KRONIQ's maximum liability for any claim is limited to the total amount charged for the project in question.
terms.section07Content2: Property provided by the Client: If the Client provides materials, photos, texts or logos over which they do not hold the rights, the responsibility falls entirely on the Client. KRONIQ does not verify the ownership of inputs provided by the Client.
terms.section08Content1: The KRONIQ website is an informational and contact platform. By using it, the visitor agrees to:
terms.section08List1: Not attempt to access restricted areas, internal systems or third-party data.
terms.section08List2: Not reproduce, copy or distribute the site's content without written authorization.
terms.section08List3: Not use the site for illicit, defamatory activities or those that violate third-party rights.
terms.section08Content2: The site may contain links to external platforms (Canva, Figma, social media). KRONIQ is not responsible for the content or privacy policies of those sites.
terms.section09Content1: KRONIQ may update these Terms when it deems necessary. Relevant changes will be notified through a notice on the site, at least 10 business days in advance before taking effect. Projects in progress are governed by the version in force at the time of their start, unless agreed otherwise.
terms.section10Content1: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United Mexican States. In the event of any controversy, the parties agree to seek a direct solution within 15 business days. If no agreement is reached, they shall submit to the jurisdiction of the competent courts of Mexico City, waiving any other jurisdiction that may correspond to them by reason of their present or future domiciles.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.subtitle: FAYRIX, S.A. DE C.V. (KRONIQ)
refund.address: CALLE SIERRA GORDA N°36, DESPACHO 305 MZ, COL. LOMAS DE CHAPULTEPEC I SECCION, ALCALDIA MIGUEL HIDALGO, C.P. 11000 ENTIDAD FEDERATIVA CIUDAD DE MÉXICO
refund.section01Content1: KRONIQ's services are developed creatively, strategically and in a personalized way for each Client, based on the brief, business objectives and the packages selected from the catalogs published on the site (visual identity, corporate branding, social media, advertising banners, editorial design, illustrations, presentations, UI design, editable templates and brand redesign). Each project involves research, creative direction and specific work hours for that brand, so it is not a generic or reusable product.
refund.section02Title: 02. CUSTOM PROJECTS AND NON-REFUNDABLE ONCE STARTED
refund.section02Content1: Due to this custom nature, all payments made for design, branding, illustration, presentation, UI or other services described on the site are non-refundable once the project has started. A project is understood to have started when KRONIQ begins any of the following activities: review and analysis of the brief, brand or competitor research, conceptual exploration, development of creative routes or preparation of initial proposals, even if the Client has not yet received any progress.
refund.section02Content2: When the Client hires a package (e.g., logo, visual identity, corporate branding, social media design, web UI, etc.), KRONIQ reserves calendar time, assigns resources and structures a process with defined stages and deliverables. If the Client decides to cancel after the project has started, the amounts paid are allocated to cover that time, planning and work already performed, so no refund will be issued.
refund.section03Content1: If the Client requests cancellation before the agreed start date and KRONIQ has not begun creative work (no brief analysis, no research, no proposal development), the Client may request cancellation of the service. In these cases, KRONIQ may evaluate the feasibility of partially or fully refunding the amount paid, considering whether administrative expenses, calendar reservations or other prior costs were generated. This will be communicated in writing and must be confirmed by KRONIQ via email or another equivalent electronic means.
refund.section04Title: 04. PAUSED PROJECTS, ABANDONMENT AND LACK OF INPUTS
refund.section04Content1: KRONIQ projects require active participation from the Client: submission of brief, materials, information, approvals and comments within reasonable timeframes. If the project is halted for reasons attributable to the Client (lack of response, prolonged delays in content delivery, internal changes, etc.), KRONIQ may:
refund.section04List1: Keep the project paused for a reasonable time, rescheduling the calendar according to availability.
refund.section04List2: Consider the project abandoned if the Client does not respond or provide inputs for a prolonged period (e.g., several weeks) and no rescheduling has been agreed.
refund.section04Content2: In the event of abandonment or cancellation by the Client once creative work has started, there will be no refunds, and payments made will cover the blocked time and work already developed, even if the planned final delivery was not reached.
refund.section05Content1: Each KRONIQ package clearly establishes the number of revision rounds and the type of deliverables included. If the Client decides not to use any of the contemplated revision rounds, no refund, discount or credit will be generated for unused revisions.
refund.section05Content2: Requests for changes that exceed the included rounds will be considered additional work and, where applicable, will be quoted and contracted separately, in accordance with the Terms and Conditions and the corresponding proposal.
refund.section06Content1: KRONIQ undertakes to deliver the work according to the scope, process and number of proposals defined in the package or accepted proposal. The nature of design and creativity involves subjective criteria, so simple subjective dissatisfaction with the style, personal taste or aesthetic preference will not be grounds for requesting a refund when the service has been provided as agreed.
refund.section06Content2: In case of dissatisfaction, the Client is invited to use the revision rounds included in their package to adjust the project within the established guidelines and scope. Any adjustment exceeding those scopes may be quoted as an additional service.
refund.section07Title: 07. PROCEDURE TO REQUEST A REFUND OR CASE REVIEW
refund.section07Content1: If the Client considers that there is an extraordinary situation that justifies reviewing their case, they must send an email to the contact address indicated on the KRONIQ site, including:
refund.section07List2: Project file number, contracted package and payment date.
refund.section07List3: Clear description of the reason for the request and the current state of the project.
refund.section07Content2: KRONIQ will analyze the request and respond in writing within a reasonable timeframe, indicating whether any type of adjustment, rescheduling or alternative solution applies. Approval of a total or partial refund will always be exceptional and at KRONIQ's discretion, without setting a precedent for future cases.

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.subtitle: FAYRIX, S.A. DE C.V.
privacy.address: Sierra Gorda 36, Desp. 305 MZ, Lomas de Chapultepec I, Alcaldía Miguel Hidalgo, C.P. 11000, CDMX
privacy.intro: We design brands that communicate clearly. This notice follows the same philosophy: to tell you exactly what we do with your information, without language that obscures instead of explaining. It complies with the LFPDPPP, its Regulations and the INAI Guidelines.
privacy.section01Title: 01. WHO IS RESPONSIBLE FOR YOUR DATA
privacy.section01Content1: FAYRIX S.A. de C.V. (hereinafter "the Controller") is the strategic design studio that owns the website and the services described on it. The following channels are available to you:
privacy.section01List1: Address: Sierra Gorda N° 36, Despacho 305 MZ, Col. Lomas de Chapultepec I Sección, Alcaldía Miguel Hidalgo, C.P. 11000, Mexico City.
privacy.section02Title: 02. WHAT INFORMATION WE KEEP AND WHY
privacy.section02Content1: Every service we offer —from an essential logo to a full rebranding— requires knowing the brand we're going to work with. That's why we collect:
privacy.section02List1: Full name and, if applicable, company name, RFC (Tax ID).
privacy.section02List3: Billing information: RFC, tax address, tax regime.
privacy.section02List4: Creative brief: information about your brand, industry, competition, audience and objectives.
privacy.section02List5: Materials and inputs provided by the client (logos, brand guides, images, documents).
privacy.section02List6: Payment data (processed by certified platforms; we do not store card data).
privacy.section02List7: IP address, browser, operating system and pages visited, through cookies. You can manage them from your browser.
privacy.section02Content2: Important note: We do not collect sensitive information. If a special project required it, we would discuss it and formalize it with your prior written consent.
privacy.section03Title: 03. WHAT WE USE WHAT YOU SHARE WITH US FOR
privacy.section03Subtitle1: Uses that make the service possible
privacy.section03List1: Prepare proposals, develop projects and deliver the agreed files.
privacy.section03List2: Manage your file number, issue CFDI invoices and process payments.
privacy.section03List3: Maintain communication about project progress and resolve questions.
privacy.section03List4: Comply with applicable tax, accounting and legal obligations.
privacy.section04Content1: We prefer to tell you what we will NOT do, because that's what really matters:
privacy.section04List1: We will not sell, rent or transfer your information to third parties for commercial purposes.
privacy.section04List2: We will not use the materials, briefs or references you give us for any purpose other than your project.
privacy.section04List3: We will not contact your team or collaborators without your prior authorization.
privacy.section04List4: We will not keep your work files beyond the necessary or legally required time.
privacy.section04List5: We will not transfer your data outside the country without contractual measures equivalent to Mexican law.
privacy.section05Title: 05. WHEN AND WITH WHOM WE SHARE
privacy.section05Content1: Some projects require external collaborators. When that happens:
privacy.section05List1: Designers, illustrators or specialists involved in the execution — they only receive what is essential, under a confidentiality agreement.
privacy.section05List2: Certified payment platforms (PCI-DSS) to process transactions.
privacy.section05List3: Digital infrastructure providers (cloud, email, storage) operating as processors under contract.
privacy.section05List4: Tax, judicial or regulatory authorities when required by law.
privacy.section05Content2: None of these transfers has commercial purposes. They are operational and always backed by a contract or a legal obligation.
privacy.section06Content1: The law grants you four rights you can exercise at any time. Here they are in plain language:
privacy.section06List1: Access — know what data we have and how we use it.
privacy.section06List2: Rectification — correct any incorrect or outdated data.
privacy.section06List3: Cancellation — ask us to delete your information from our systems.
privacy.section06List4: Opposition — tell us to stop using it for a specific purpose.
privacy.section06Content2: To exercise any of these rights, send a message to the channels indicated in Section 01 with: full name, copy of official ID, the right you wish to exercise and, if you have a representative, the document that accredits them. We will respond within a maximum of 20 business days.
privacy.section06Content3: If you believe your request was not properly addressed, you can file a complaint with the INAI at www.inai.org.mx.
privacy.section07Title: 07. HOW LONG WE KEEP YOUR DATA
privacy.section07Content1: We do not keep information indefinitely:
privacy.section07List1: Contract and billing data: 5 years, due to tax obligations.
privacy.section07List2: Project files, briefs and materials: up to 60 calendar days after final delivery, unless otherwise agreed.
privacy.section07List3: Active contact data: during the commercial relationship and up to 2 additional years.
privacy.section07List4: Browsing data: according to our Cookie Policy published on the site.
privacy.section07Content2: After these periods, your data is blocked and irreversibly deleted or disassociated.
privacy.section08Title: 08. IF SOMETHING CHANGES, WE WILL TELL YOU
privacy.section08Content1: Any relevant modification to this notice will be published on the site with a visible update date. Continuing to use our services after that date means accepting the changes. The current version will always be available on the website.
